newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Telecom, EDP sale dates unchanged-Finmin.
newsitem.headline: Telecom, EDP sale dates unchanged-Finmin.

text.p: The privatisation of up to 49 percent of state electricity concern EDP is still set for May, with the sale of a further slice of Portugal Telecom (PT) slated for a few months later, Portugal's deputy finance minister told Reuters on Monday.
Fernando Teixeira dos Santos denied weekend newspaper reports that the sale order could be inverted, with Portugal Telecom going first.
"The EDP operation is in May and is the first. That of PT will be, very probably, in September. There is no alteration in the timetable," he said in a telephone interview.
"It is the Finance Ministry that decides the timings and I do not understand why there are certain things in the newspapers that simply generate confusion," Teixeira dos Santos said.
Planning Minister Joao Cravinho was quoted by newspapers on Saturday as saying that the sale of a further 26 percent of Portugal Telecom could be brought forward.
But Teixeira dos Santos firmly excluded this possibility.
"It does not make any sense...it was decided long ago that EDP would be the first operation," he said.
The government has provisionally set May 19 for the sale.
